answer: Cut walking and packing waits: they take [F6] and [F8] of each order's time, and fixing them is the route from [F3] same-day shipping to the [F9] target.
exec_summary: The warehouse ships [F2] of [F1] orders a day the same day, [F3].
Each order takes [F4] minutes; walking takes [F5] and packing waits [F7].
The same-day target of [F9] is [F10] above today.
situation: A regional distributor whose warehouse ships orders daily.
complication: Many orders miss same-day dispatch, and overtime has helped only a little.
key_question: Where does order time go in the warehouse, and what would lift same-day shipping?

titles.options: Two ways to lift same-day shipping.
titles.recommendation: Batch picking and balance the packing bench.
titles.roadmap: Cut walking first, then fix packing waits.
titles.kpis: Two measures show the warehouse is faster.
titles.risks: The main risk is moving the bottleneck to packing.

issue_tree.finding: Walking is the largest share of order time.
points: Walking takes [F5] minutes of each order, [F6] of the time.
Pickers pick one order at a time across the whole warehouse.

hypotheses.text: Batch picking would cut walking time.

issue_tree.so_what: Cutting walking is the biggest single lever on order time.

chart.title: Share of order time by activity.

issue_tree.finding: Orders wait at the packing bench after picking.
points: Packing waits take [F7] minutes, [F8] of order time.

hypotheses.text: Packing is understaffed at peak times.

issue_tree.so_what: Faster picking will only help if packing keeps up.

issue_tree.finding: Extra hours did little for same-day shipping.
points: Overtime last quarter helped only a little.

hypotheses.text: More hours alone will reach the target.

issue_tree.so_what: The fix is in the process, not more hours.

options.name: Batch and rebalance
options.description: Pick several orders per walk and move staff to packing at peaks.

options.name: Re-slot fast movers
options.description: Move the fastest-selling items near packing to shorten walks.

recommendation.rationale: It targets both walking at [F6] and packing waits at [F8] without a new building; the operations director decides.

actions: Trial batch picking in one zone and time it.
Give the operations director the plan within the four weeks.
Roll batch picking out to all zones and move staff to packing at peaks.
Re-time orders and compare same-day shipping with the target.

risks.mitigation: Move pickers to packing when the bench queue builds.
Check a sample of batched orders each day.
